repos.tagline: Collision-free articulated-arm motion planning to SBS microplate wells and visuo-tactile manipulation engineering map for transparent lab vessels.
repos.object: Serves as the physical manipulation and contact-sensing half of Layer L1 in Auto-Lab: planning collision-free trajectories that move pipette tips, tubes, and microplates around benchtop obstacles while establishing the visuo-tactile roadmap for the 'last centimeter' of manipulation where optical depth cameras fail on clear glass and polypropylene vessels.
repos.data: Synthetic ANSI/SLAS (SBS) 96-well plate geometry (8x12 grid, 9 mm well pitch, origin [0.20, 0.05] m, supporting both row-major and column-major 1-based indexing) paired with a planar 2-link arm (L1=0.30 m, L2=0.25 m), source tube at (-0.05, 0.40) m, two static AABB bench obstacles (tube rack wall and reagent bottle), and 100 seeded planning episodes (10 wells x 10 seeds), alongside 9 curated robot, transparent-depth, and optical-tactile datasets.
repos.model: Analytical 2-link revolute forward and inverse kinematics (fk, ik with elbow=+1/-1 branch fallback), 30-point discrete link-vs-AABB collision and 0.02 rad joint-edge checking (in_collision, edge_free), vectorized joint-space Rapidly-exploring Random Tree planner (iters=3000, step=0.15 rad, goal_bias=0.1), and 100-iteration randomized waypoint shortcut smoother (demo/plan_to_well.py).
repos.training: Classical sampling-based geometric planner with zero learned weights today: resolves 10/10 obstacle-blocked straight-line moves with 100/100 (100.0%) RRT success across 10 seeds, reducing mean joint path length from 2.44 rad to 2.08 rad (-14.8%) via shortcutting. Designed as the kinematic and well-indexing scaffold prior to 3D MuJoCo simulation and demonstration-trained ACT, Diffusion Policy, and visuo-tactile VLA models.
repos.history: Initial baseline eb4d967 on main (2026-11-18: planar 2R kinematics, dual-order SBS 96-well mapping, joint-space RRT + shortcut smoother, 100-trial CPU benchmark, GitHub Actions CI, and curated manipulation/transparent-object/tactile resources) and architecture documentation 8213dab on main.
unique_properties: Pure-NumPy single-file motion planner (requirements.txt = 'numpy') requiring zero simulator binaries, ROS/MoveIt/OMPL dependencies, or GPU drivers.
Explicit dual-order SBS 96-well coordinate translation (well 65 -> F5 row-major vs A9 column-major), preventing row/column transposition bugs between plate readers and liquid handlers.
Non-trivial cluttered-bench benchmark construction: 10 out of 10 target wells are blocked along straight-line joint interpolation by the reagent bottle obstacle.

repos.tagline: Teacher-to-student logit distillation and byte-packed int8/4-bit post-training quantization baseline for low-power benchtop inference.
repos.object: Forms the L0 compute substrate of Auto-Lab so the lab agent can run autonomously on inexpensive edge boards mounted beside instruments: cloud GPUs train large teacher models in short bursts, while compact student networks are distilled, quantized to int8 and packed 4-bit weights, and executed locally with deterministic batch-1 latency.
repos.data: Uses scikit-learn's bundled 8x8 handwritten digits dataset (1,797 images, 64 features, 10 classes, BSD-3-Clause), split stratified 70/30 into 1,257 training and 540 test samples (SEED=0) with train-fitted StandardScaler preprocessing, exported into canonical float32 (W, b) tuples, signed int8 arrays, and two's-complement nibble-packed uint8 4-bit buffers.
repos.model: ReLU MLPClassifier teacher with hidden layers (256, 256) (85,002 params, 340,008 B fp32) paired with 32-unit single-hidden-layer ReLU students (2,410 params, 9,640 B fp32; 35.3x fewer parameters) compressed via symmetric per-tensor post-training weight quantization to int8 (2,544 B) and packed two-nibbles-per-byte signed 4-bit (1,360 B; 250.0x smaller than teacher), evaluated through one shared numpy forward pass.
repos.training: Compares hard-label cross-entropy student training (MLPClassifier, max_iter=300) against high-temperature scaled logit regression (MLPRegressor fit to teacher pre-softmax logits / T at T=4.0, max_iter=500, avoiding premature tol stopping on flat softmax targets). Honestly documents both that hard-label training slightly beats pure uncentered logit MSE on this clean toy task (0.9741 vs 0.9685) and that quantized models run dequantized fp32 matmuls in numpy (saving 3.8x-7.1x memory with 100% int8 / 98.89% 4-bit prediction agreement, while wall-clock integer speedups await C++/NPU runtimes).
repos.history: Initial baseline a7b1532 on main (2026-11-18: teacher-student T=4.0 logit distillation, symmetric int8 and packed 4-bit round-trip quantizer, Xeon batch-1 latency benchmark, GitHub Actions CI, and curated quantization/edge-runtime survey) and architecture documentation 6a600de on main.
unique_properties: True two's-complement nibble packing and unpacking (pack_4bit / unpack_4bit, two signed -8..7 weights per uint8 byte) verified in-loop during accuracy evaluation rather than simulated via float clamping alone.
Framework-neutral batch-1 latency harness (200 warmup + 2,000 single-sample passes) using a single raw numpy forward() kernel across classifier, regressor, and quantized variants.

250x end-to-end model footprint reduction from fp32 teacher (340,008 bytes) to 4-bit distilled student (1,360 bytes, including fp32 biases and per-tensor fp32 scales) within 1.3 percentage points of teacher accuracy.
Foundational L0 compression target for lab-ears acoustic autoencoders/Whisper models (L2), lab-hands SmolVLA/BitVLA manipulation policies (L1), and YLM equivariant molecular heads (L3).

io_contract.inputs: Standardized 64-dimensional float32 feature vectors (sklearn 8x8 digits), fitted sklearn MLP estimators, distillation temperature T=4.0, and target quantization bit-widths (8 or 4).
io_contract.outputs: Extracted float32 and quantized/dequantized (W, b) layer lists, byte-accurate packed 4-bit uint8 weight buffers, test accuracy, top-1 prediction agreement, and batch-1 CPU latency tables.
